program:
PARAMS = {
    "Is":      (100e-6, 40e-6, 250e-6),  # starving current per stage (tt, Vctrl mid)
    "k":       (4.0, 2.0, 8.0),          # mirror ratio starver/bias branch
    "gmid_s":  (8.0, 5.0, 14.0),         # gm/Id of starving mirrors
    "Ls":      (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),         # L of starving mirrors
    "gmid_in": (14.0, 8.0, 20.0),        # V-to-I control device gm/Id (high -> Vgs ~ Vth, R dominates)
    "Wn_inv":  (0.84, 0.42, 3.0),        # ring inverter nfet width (pfet = 2x)
    "Wbuf_n":  (1.0, 0.42, 4.0),         # output buffer nfet width (pfet = 2x)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vlo, vhi = spec.get("vctrl_range", [0.7, 1.4])
    vmid = 0.5 * (vlo + vhi)
    Is = p["Is"]; k = p["k"]; Ib = Is / k
    gs, Ls = p["gmid_s"], p["Ls"]

    # ---- V-to-I converter: vctrl -> Min (degenerated by R1) -> PMOS diode pb
    m_in = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], 0.5, Ib, vds=0.35)
    R1 = max((vmid - m_in.vgs) / Ib, 1e3)
    # PMOS diode + mirror into NMOS diode (both at Ib, same L/gmid as starvers)
    mpd = lut.size("p", gs, Ls, Ib, vds=1.0)
    mnd = lut.size("n", gs, Ls, Ib, vds=0.7)
    # starvers: same L, gm/Id -> W scales by k
    mps = lut.size("p", gs, Ls, Is, vds=0.3)
    mns = lut.size("n", gs, Ls, Is, vds=0.3)

    Wn = p["Wn_inv"]; Wp = 2.0 * Wn
    Wbn = p["Wbuf_n"]; Wbp = 2.0 * Wbn
    Linv = 0.15

    n = Netlist("vctrl vout vdd vss")
    # bias
    n.dev("Min", "pb", "vctrl", "ns", "vss", m_in)
    n.R("R1", "ns", "vss", R1)
    n.dev("MPd", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mpd)
    n.dev("MP2", "nb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mpd)
    n.dev("MNd", "nb", "nb", "vss", "vss", mnd)
    # 3-stage current-starved ring
    N = 3
    nodes = ["r0", "r1", "r2"]
    for i in range(N):
        a = nodes[i]; y = nodes[(i + 1) % N]
        n.dev(f"MPS{i}", f"sp{i}", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mps)
        n.M(f"MPI{i}", y, a, f"sp{i}", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Linv)
        n.M(f"MNI{i}", y, a, f"sn{i}", "vss", "nfet", Wn, Linv)
        n.dev(f"MNS{i}", f"sn{i}", "nb", "vss", "vss", mns)
    # output buffer (rail-to-rail swing on vout)
    n.M("MBP", "vout", "r0", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wbp, 0.15)
    n.M("MBN", "vout", "r0", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wbn, 0.15)

    # ---- first-order predictions
    cg = 1.8e-15   # F/um gate cap (L=0.15 incl. overlap)
    cd = 1.0e-15   # F/um drain junction/overlap
    C_node = (Wn + Wp) * (cg + cd) + (Wbn + Wbp) * cg / N + 1.5e-15
    vdd = 1.8
    f_mid = 0.8 * Is / (N * C_node * vdd)          # 0.8: finite-edge fudge
    Ibuf = 5e-15 * vdd * f_mid + 0.1 * Is         # self-load + short-circuit est. (CL excluded)
    power = vdd * (Is + 2 * Ib) + vdd * Ibuf
    # Is ~ (Vctrl - Vgs)/R -> tuning slope ~ 1/R
    f_lo = f_mid * max(vlo - m_in.vgs, 0.05) / (vmid - m_in.vgs)
    f_hi = f_mid * (vhi - m_in.vgs) / (vmid - m_in.vgs)
    return n, {
        "f_mid": f_mid, "f_lo": f_lo, "f_hi": f_hi,
        "tuning_ratio": f_hi / f_lo,
        "kvco": (f_hi - f_lo) / (vhi - vlo),
        "swing": 1.7, "power": power,
    }
